crons.//: Every five minutes, raised from hourly by Module 26. THE PRODUCT HAS EXACTLY ONE CLOCK and this is it: stale-stage rules, approval expiry and the 'Wait, then…' queue all drain from this single sweep. Hourly was fine while the only time-based rule was 'sat in a stage for three days'; the default recruitment flow added a 15-minute pre-call reminder and a 30-minute post-call wait, and on an hourly cron a 30-minute wait fires between 30 and 90 minutes late while a 15-minute reminder routinely arrives after the call it warns about. Five minutes bounds every delay's error at five minutes. Do not add a second cron entry for delays — the sweep already drains them.
